checkpoint.title: Celadon Mansion: the TEA on 1F, then the roof room, saved facing the Eevee's ball

events.why: from outside the Game Corner in by Celadon Mansion's front door (30, 11) to above the old woman (2, 9), west of the Nidoran's zone (3..7, 7..9)
the old woman gives the TEA (CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_EventScript_TeaWoman, FLAG_GOT_TEA), for the Saffron gate guards (15.01)
out of the front door again and round to the back door (30, 4), whose part of 1F has the stairs: up 2F and 3F to the roof, down into the roof room at (2, 12), and below the Eevee's ball (7, 3)

checkpoint: PokeGuy takes the TEA and the Eevee after the Rocket Hideout and before Route 16's house. Celadon Mansion (CeladonCity_Condominiums_* map.json): 1F's stairs (4, 2) or (12, 2) to 2F, 3F, and 3F's (4, 2) or (12, 2) up to the roof; the roof's door (2, 12) leads down into the roof room, whose Eevee's ball (7, 3) is CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_EventScript_EeveeBall. 1F's Clefairy (4..6, 13) and Nidoran (3..7, 7..9) wander.
facing_eevee_ball: Gift RNG starts from a save facing the ball.
